scenarios.name: first-attack-at-most-life-untaps-and-grants-combat
scenarios.why: Scourge attacks for the first time this turn while its defending player is tied for the most life, so its attack trigger occurs; dethrone also adds a +1/+1 counter.

scenarios.name: not-most-life-no-first-attack-trigger
scenarios.why: Scourge's controller has more life than the defending player, so the defending player is not the player with the most life; neither its first-attack trigger nor dethrone triggers.
